## When you must register

A business must register for GST once its GST turnover reaches $75,000 or more
per year. This is referred to as the GST turnover threshold. Turnover is tested
on either the previous twelve months or the projected next twelve months,
whichever reaches the threshold first.

## Non-profit organisations

A non-profit organisation has a higher GST registration threshold of $150,000
per year or more.

## Taxi, limousine and ride-sourcing

A business providing taxi, limousine or ride-sourcing services must register for
GST regardless of its GST turnover.

## Time limit to register

Once registration is required, it must be completed within 21 days. A business
that registers late may be liable for GST on sales made from the date
registration was required, together with penalties and interest.
